title: constraint-annotations.json — per-child SGDC/SDC annotations (authored by assemble from the reaped child reports)
description: What each child's RTL implies for the constraint files, in the child's REAL module names so `sync_cell -name` matches the netlist. The lint-cdc and synthesis agents read this to fill scripts/constraints.sgdc and the SDC exceptions. Kept separate from rtl-files.json because simulation consumes only the file layout: bundling them would invalidate simulation on an annotation-only edit. Every category is present with an explicit empty array when a child has none — an omitted category and 'none' are not the same claim, and check-conformance verifies the reported module names are real. An empty object is a legitimate transient state before wave 2 has reaped any child; the roster requirement lives in the post exit gate.

sync_cell.description: Module names of custom synchronizers this child authored.

reset_synchronizer.description: Module names of reset synchronizers this child authored.

set_case_analysis.description: Test-control ports held at a constant during analysis.

quasi_static.description: Signals that cross domains but change only at configuration time.

create_generated_clock.description: Divider/PLL outputs this child generates: the module and the pin the clock leaves on. clocks.json marks the clock `generated` and defers the pin to here.
